statements.attributed: altered the size of honeycomb cells by manipulating the thermal gradient G and solidification rate R
statements.quote: It should be noted that by manipulating the process parameters of the 3D printing, i.e., the thermal gradient, G, and the solidification rate, R, the size of the honeycomb cells can be altered (Supplementary Fig. 2).

statements.attributed: reported that the equiatomic CrCoNi alloy displays a tensile strength exceeding 1 GPa and is one of the toughest reported materials on record
statements.quote: Face-centered cubic medium- and high-entropy alloys, particularly involved CrCoNi-based alloys have shown excellent mechanical properties when conventionally (“top-down”) processed; indeed, the equiatomic CrCoNi alloy, which displays a tensile strength exceeding 1 GPa, is one of the toughest reported materials on record (although the initial yield strength can be below 1 GPa).

statements.attributed: reported that the strain hardening increases strength yet at the same time delays plastic instability by necking to promote ductility
statements.quote: These alloys have a remarkably simple, single-phase microstructure of nominally equiaxed grains, yet derive their strength and toughness from a synergistic sequence of deformation mechanisms, involving dislocation slip, stacking-fault formation, nano-twinning and phase transformation, to generate prolonged and continuous strain hardening; the strain hardening increases strength yet at the same time delays plastic instability by necking to promote ductility – the “perfect storm” to create very high toughness.
